notes: CardDemo CBSTM03A (job CREASTMT, STEP040), the statement writer: it walks PSA -> TCB -> TIOT to DISPLAY its job, step and DD names (register A2; `mvs_step` states the step, the DDs in CREASTMT.JCL order, on both sides), then drives CBSTM03B (CALLed, compiled and translated as a subprogram) through TRNXFILE, XREFFILE, CUSTFILE and ACCTFILE and writes the plain-text (STMTFILE) and HTML (HTMLFILE) statements, both compared with SYSOUT. TRNXFILE is the first three records of the corpus's dailytran.txt (trnx.txt here); the other three files are the corpus's own data.
